name: valid-before-first-record
rule: Preparation can exist before a record.

name: valid-after-first-record
rule: A matching record does not prevent preparation.

name: valid-second-person
rule: Different people can have different assignments.

name: pending-without-company-email
rule: Email access cannot require company email to exist.

name: incomplete-recipient
rule: Partial preparation is valid; readiness is separate.

name: pending-without-assignment
rule: Incomplete arrangements stay visible.

name: requested-without-assignment
rule: Incomplete arrangements stay visible.

name: deferred-without-assignment
rule: Incomplete arrangements stay visible.

name: past-target-remains-valid
rule: A passed target cannot invalidate preparation.

name: repeated-contact-data
rule: Repeated contact data is not a duplicate identity.

name: empty-arrangements
rule: There may be no arrangements yet.

name: null-arrangements
rule: An absent list is not a completion claim.

name: matching-case-sensitive-account
rule: Identity is preserved exactly.

name: version-precedes-kind-and-identity
rule: Unsupported version is the only result.

name: wrong-kind
rule: A record is not preparation.

name: missing-account
rule: Missing identity is not incomplete preparation.

name: unsafe-account
rule: An account cannot contain path separators.

name: account-case-mismatch
rule: Identity is case sensitive.

name: wrong-person
rule: Another person's preparation must be refused.

name: missing-plan
rule: Preparation identifies its plan.

name: wrong-plan
rule: Another plan's preparation must be refused.

name: record-wrong-person
rule: An existing record identifies the same person.

name: record-wrong-plan
rule: An existing record identifies the same plan.

name: identity-errors-stop-details
rule: Do not read details after identity mismatch.

name: multiple-identity-errors
rule: Identity errors have fixed field order.

name: unknown-team
rule: A supplied team exists.

name: unknown-manager
rule: A supplied contact exists.

name: unknown-onboardingOwner
rule: A supplied contact exists.

name: unknown-contact
rule: A supplied contact exists.

name: invalid-planned-start-date
rule: A supplied date is a real calendar date.

name: invalid-planned-start-date-spelling
rule: Do not normalize ambiguous date spelling.

name: invalid-location
rule: Location uses a bounded vocabulary.

name: unknown-section
rule: An arrangement names a known section instance.

name: missing-section
rule: An arrangement needs its activity reference.

name: missing-arrangement-id
rule: An arrangement ID cannot be empty.

name: duplicate-identical-arrangement
rule: Matching duplicate IDs are invalid.

name: duplicate-conflicting
rule: Conflicting duplicates fail in either order.

name: duplicate-conflicting-reversed
rule: Conflicting duplicates fail in either order.

name: distinct-arrangements-same-section
rule: One activity can have several distinct arrangements.

name: unknown-kind
rule: Kind has a bounded vocabulary.

name: unknown-status
rule: A newcomer outcome is not a preparation status.

name: missing-status
rule: Do not silently infer status.

name: unknown-owner
rule: An owner names a contact.

name: unknown-support
rule: A support contact exists.

name: invalid-target
rule: A target is a real calendar date.

name: arranged-without-owner
rule: Arranged preparation names its accountable owner.

name: arranged-pairing-without-partner
rule: Arranged pairing needs a partner.

name: arranged-pairing-without-ticket
rule: Arranged pairing needs a work reference.

name: deploy-shadow-with-support
rule: Deployment roles are explicit.

name: deploy-shadow-without-support
rule: An arranged deployment needs experienced support.

name: deploy-lead-with-support
rule: Deployment roles are explicit.

name: deploy-lead-without-support
rule: An arranged deployment needs experienced support.

name: stable-arrangement-reorder
rule: List position is not identity.

name: ordered-detail-errors
rule: Recipient errors precede arrangement errors.

name: valid-kind-support
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-equipment
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-office
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-remote
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-access
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-meeting
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-reading
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-ticket
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-pr-review
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-pr-post
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: valid-kind-pr-merge
rule: Every declared arrangement kind is usable.

name: support-without-resource
rule: Support need not invent a work item.

name: blank-reference
rule: Arranged work needs meaningful reference content.

name: unsafe-arrangement-id
rule: Arrangement IDs have an explicit grammar.

name: dot-account
rule: A path-like dot account is invalid.

name: unknown-empty-helper
rule: An empty helper item is not an empty helper list.

name: valid-leap-day
rule: Date validation follows the calendar, not a loose pattern.

name: non-leap-day
rule: A matching date pattern is insufficient.

name: optional-dates
rule: Preparation can start before dates are known.

name: on-site-location
rule: On-site location is supported.

name: hybrid-location
rule: Hybrid location is supported.
